description: Connect a subdomain to your published DeliverIT website and validate its HTTPS certificate. Existing website records at that subdomain may be replaced. Root-domain forwarding is not included.
variableDescription: acmToken: the 32-character AWS certificate validation token without its leading underscore. acmTarget: the AWS-provided validation target before .acm-validations.aws, including its leading underscore. The standard host parameter selects the website subdomain.
